test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

By whom were you taught English grammar and composition?

options.text: Who has taught you English grammar and composition?
Whom taught you English grammar and composition?
Who had taught you English grammar and composition?
Who taught you English grammar and composition?

solution:
The correct answer is: **Who taught you English grammar and composition?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **subject** of the **Active Voice** is usually changed into the **object** of the **Passive Voice**, and vice versa.
 
• The usage of a **helping verb** is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive and vice versa.
 
• The provided sentence is in **Passive Voice**.
 
• To change it to **Active Voice**, identify the **subject** (who) and place it at the beginning.
 
• The format for the active voice is: **Who + (past tense of verb) + you + (object).**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Who taught you English grammar and composition?**
